items.title: 3 Financial Stocks Benefiting From High Short Term Rates and Client Cash Balances
items.summary: Fed officials are still talking tough on rates while mortgages hover near 6.95% and auto loans sit close to 9.49%. At the same time, cash parked in short‑duration and money‑market strategies is finally earning something again. That mix can reward investors who understand which stocks gain from higher short‑term yields and tighter credit. This article unpacks that story and walks through 3 stocks exposed to these forces from the U.S. Short‑Duration Cash & Money‑Market Asset Managers...
